about: A free download manager written in Python and run from a web page.

prs.title: Checksum checks finish instead of hanging forever
prs.broken: With the checksum add-on on, any download that came with an SFV or CRC file never finished, and pyLoad kept a processor core busy until killed.
prs.changed: The check now stops at the end of the file, so it completes and reports the result.
prs.matters: Downloads get verified and finish, and the machine is not tied up.

prs.title: Checksum reads .md5 files correctly
prs.broken: With the checksum add-on on, every .md5 file failed, because it took the hash as the file name.
prs.changed: It now reads the hash and the name in the right order, in both md5sum formats.
prs.matters: Downloads that ship an .md5 file get checked instead of throwing an error.
